clusters.title: Agent identity/prompt is sourced from 4+ unreconciled mechanisms, and the skill.md persona pipeline is dead
clusters.rationale: Highest-leverage architectural fragmentation in the audit. Four scouts independently converged: editing dharma_swarm/skills/*.skill.md has ZERO effect on any spawned agent because _build_system_prompt never consults SkillRegistry; it falls back to a hardcoded daemon_config.ROLE_BRIEFINGS dict carrying older PSMV-era prompts for the same role names (cartographer/archeologist/surgeon/architect/validator). create_from_skill (the only skill->prompt bridge) has no downstream caller. Meanwhile agent_constitution.py, autonomous_agent.py + holon_bridge.load_holon are a 4th/5th prompt source. Blast radius: every agent spawn; recurrence: guaranteed drift on every skill.md edit; evidence strength: high (grep-confirmed no wiring); vision-code misalignment: CLAUDE.md documents skill.md as the swarm subagent role registry but it is unreachable. Durable fix is well-scoped (unify the prompt-construction seam).

clusters.title: INTERFACE_MISMATCH_MAP.md — the repo's designated #1-runtime-failure tracker — is itself unreliable: resolve→reopen→different-fix cycles hid a production-dead loop for months
clusters.rationale: CLAUDE.md names this doc as THE first thing to check before any bug/feature and says it 'rotted twice'. History mining confirms a systemic meta-tracking failure: at least two confirmed resolve-then-reopen-under-new-ID cycles (message_bus semantics claimed RESOLVED for ~3 months while live; WorldModelAgent MM-13 'resolved' on an unmerged branch while main crashed 147x/day, re-filed as NEW-14 BLOCKER ~2.5 months later), header self-contradiction flip-flops, chronic PARTIAL/GUARDED items that never converge, and 2/9 bootstrap fixes marked resolved same-day that slid. Blast radius: every agent that trusts the map is misled about what is broken vs fixed. Evidence strength: very high (the doc's own commit messages call out 'doc-rot that misled multiple sessions'). Durable fix: the tracking mechanism needs a truthfulness gate (verified-by-test/commit-on-main, not existence-grep).

clusters.title: Vision-code misalignment: the marquee 'living system' organs are dormant-by-default flags, and research vocabulary (R_V) is reused metaphorically without the measurement it names
clusters.rationale: A coherent recurring pattern of scaffolding/vocabulary out-producing verifiable behavior — CLAUDE.md's Key Abstractions read as standing production reality but Organism (composition root), StrangeLoop (self-mod), and MemoryKernel (canonical memory front door) are all off-by-default behind flags no shipped config sets; DarwinEngine apply is shadow-gated. Moderate severity but high vision-code-misalignment and agent-trust cost: agents/operators reading CLAUDE.md or an 'rv' field are misled about what runs and what was measured. Leverage: a documentation-accuracy pass + a decision on whether to earn-in or de-scope.

clusters.title: Track-portfolio governance runs on a shared unlocked YAML with shallow closure gates and cross-track blocker duplication
clusters.rationale: The governance layer that agents are told to trust (make onboard / ACTIVE_TRACK.yaml) has demonstrated coordination failures: a SHIPPED track was silently resurrected ACTIVE for ~24 days by a stale long-lived PR merge with no CI check guarding closed_tracks; closure gates were 'existence-grep' shallow and needed two hardening passes in a week (some tracks graded SHIPPED before the rigorous gate existed); and the SAME 'provision the daemon VPS' human action is restated near-verbatim as a local next-item in THREE active tracks, so every session touching any of them re-describes one pending action. Blast radius: portfolio state agents act on. Leverage: a merge-time invariant on ACTIVE_TRACK.yaml + a shared cross-track blocker record + retroactive re-verification of pre-gate closures.
clusters.investigation_prompt:
Investigate track-portfolio governance integrity in dharma_swarm (/home/user/dharma_swarm). The active-track portfolio (docs/governance/ACTIVE_TRACK.yaml, rendered by make onboard) is the coordination surface agents are told to trust, but history mining found coordination failures. Verify each and recommend durable guards.

1. Silent resurrection via stale PR: runtime-truth-reconciliation-2026-06 was closed SHIPPED 2026-06-06 (commit c28951d, opened 06-04), then PR #555 merge on 2026-06-09 (dbbc4588) — branched before the 06-06 close — silently reintroduced it as ACTIVE; it then survived a re-verification (f017f75 bumped verified_at 06-20->06-23) and was only really closed 2026-07-01 (dd02c1e0). Root cause: single shared coordination YAML, no lock, no CI diff verifying a merge never removes a closed_tracks entry or resurrects a closed id as ACTIVE without a new closed_at/evidence. The same class recurs with any long-lived PR touching ACTIVE_TRACK.yaml (PR #796 dharmagraph spans days).
2. Shallow closure gates: commit 8f688e9f (2026-06-23) 'rigorous track-closure gate - evidence, not existence-grep' implies prior gates only checked file/pattern existence; same-day f017f753 found runtime-truth-nats-2026-06's criteria 'only grep a spec doc for the literal NATS'; dd02c1e0 (2026-07-01) 'harden active-track final boss gate' was a further pass. Some of the ~15 already-closed tracks were graded SHIPPED before the rigorous gate existed.
3. Cross-track duplicate blocker: the SAME unresolved 'provision the daemon VPS/host' action is restated near-verbatim as a local next-item in THREE active tracks — loop-closure-2026-06 ('operator runs it on the daemon host...'), organism-rewire-2026-07 ('VPS shift: daemon onto an always-on VPS... Operator provisions host'), dharmagraph-engine-2026-07 ('Operator: provision the ONE daemon VPS'). One human action, restated 3x, reworded (d4e982e8 reframed a hard blocker to 'CODE+DOCS DONE... REMAINING: operator observation') rather than closed.

Deliver: (a) confirm the resurrection sequence and whether any CI check today guards ACTIVE_TRACK.yaml merges; (b) recommend a merge-time invariant (a closed track cannot silently return to ACTIVE; closed_tracks entries cannot be removed) and how to express it in CI; (c) recommend a single shared cross-track blocker record (an ops-item id the three tracks reference instead of each restating the VPS need); (d) recommend retroactively re-verifying all already-closed tracks against the post-2026-06-23 rigorous criteria (test_passes/commit_on_main), and identify which closures predate the gate. Read scripts/governance/check_track_status.py and the closure-gate scripts to ground the CI recommendation.
